context: Hina helps Yumiko clean the kitchen.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ひなちゃん、掃除、一緒に、しよう。
lines.style: Warm, inviting opening. Soft maternal tone with genuine affection. Natural pace, unhurried. The kind of voice that makes a child feel included and safe.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Yes! Hina will try really hard!
lines.style: Bright, eager commitment. Quick attack on the affirmative, then a slight lean forward in energy. Genuine childish enthusiasm without performing it. Small-child sincerity.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Soft teaching tone, unhurried. Light emphasis on 'gently' — guiding without correcting. Warm and present. The voice of someone genuinely enjoying this moment.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright, uncomplicated joy. Quick pace, open vowels. A small child discovering the simple pleasure of doing something alongside an adult. Genuine delight, no self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Quiet, tender appreciation. Spoken almost to herself, but audible to Hina. Slight warmth-catch in the voice, the real feeling underneath. A moment of seeing her daughter clearly.
